AGO.note: No rule or authority on AI harms stated.
The AI use stated is inside the tax administration, a sector system, so it is not general administration.

facts.fact: AGT chair José Leiria says Angola's tax management system uses artificial intelligence to cross-reference electronic invoices with import documents and detect inconsistencies.
AGT chair José Leiria says the tax intelligence system found that 15,000 of about 40,000 zero-value company declarations received in April and May carried out transactions.

AGO.note: No AI model, dataset or computing built or hosted in the country is stated.

facts.fact: AGT chair José Leiria describes a tax management system in use that uses AI and lets the tax administration cross-reference electronic invoices with import documents.

AGO.note: NIF suspensions and registrations are described, but no computerised register is stated.
